format: UCWDC ProAm / ProPro, gender and Mixed-Role

source.quote_free_summary: ProAm and ProPro pairs in non-Mixed-Role divisions are a male leader student with their pro or a female follower student with their pro (momentary role reversals accepted); in Mixed-Role divisions a follower or leader of any gender with their pro, roles retained throughout each Dance Category.

requirement: A future UCWDC ProAm/ProPro profile must enforce the traditional and Mixed-Role pair shapes, including which role the student holds, with role consistency throughout each Dance Category.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: gender collection, columns, migrations, role-lock enforcement, UI.
interpretation_notes: Studio's ProAm shape requires one student, one professional and opposite lead/follow in either order, which is compatible with Mixed-Role but not with the traditional-division rule, which needs gender data. The clause is worded around a student and their pro for both ProAm and ProPro; how a ProPro pair (two professionals) maps to it is unclear in the text read, so no interpretation is chosen.
decision_refs: OD-27 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B retain Studio/Custom role flexibility; document body limitations; retrospective audit PR #795)
